entities.summary: Farid Anfasa Moeloek is an Indonesian physician and professor of obstetrics and gynaecology at the University of Indonesia. He was Indonesia's minister of health from 1998 to 1999, serving in the last cabinet of President Suharto and president B. J. Habibie's cabinet.
